scope: Independent static inspection of actual new-edition PDF boxes, page pixels, type geometry, physical fold model and crop mark strokes; no printer or Adobe application claim.

independent_fold_model.flip_axis: vertical short 297mm edge of A3 landscape

bleed_interpretation: White bleed is valid where the page edge is intentionally white. Ink evidence comes from the actual source and is compared with the imposed sheet, not from a label or empty box.
